root_cause_diagnosis.status: RESOLVED — not an outage, a Worker query-size bug
root_cause_diagnosis.evidence: wrangler tail on qnfo-memory-mcp captured the exception: 'VECTOR_QUERY_ERROR (code = 40025): with returnValues=true or returnMetadata=all, max top K is 50, but got 60; for a top K up to 100, retry with returnValues=false and returnMetadata=indexed'. Stack: tool_search_papers (worker.js:54) -> callTool (worker.js:307) -> fetch (worker.js:361).
root_cause_diagnosis.mechanism: tool_search_papers queries Vectorize with topK = 3 x requested limit (rerank buffer) + returnValues=true. Cloudflare caps topK at 50 for that mode. Empirical verification: limit=16 -> topK=48 -> SUCCESS; limit=17 -> topK=51 -> Error 1101. Every prior 'outage' (11:50Z, 17:53Z, 18:06Z) was the same bug triggered by limit>=17 calls; the probe at limit=3 worked because topK=9.
root_cause_diagnosis.fix: One line in worker.js:54: clamp topK to <=50 when returnValues=true (e.g. Math.min(topK, 50)) or set returnValues=false with returnMetadata=indexed.
root_cause_diagnosis.blocked_on: Workers Scripts Edit permission: content download returned 405 'Method not allowed for this authentication scheme' for all three token sources (tokens/cloudflare, keys.json cloudflare_api_token, .env CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN). Owner action required (token with Workers Scripts:Edit or dashboard edit).
root_cause_diagnosis.workaround_verified: limit<=16 works reliably (topK<=48). All sweep calls executed at limit=16.
